description: Look up npm package names on the public registry (registry.npmjs.org). Returns not_found when the registry has no such package or cannot be reached, suspicious when the registry answers with an error other than 404, and suspicious when the package was first published less than 14 days ago and its name is within 2 character edits of a popular package (a typosquat signal), or when it has an empty description, no listed maintainers and 3 or fewer published versions. Anything else is ok, which only means none of these signals fired; it is not a security review of the package. Useful when an agent is about to add a dependency the project has not used before.

packageName.description: Single npm package name to validate.

packageNames.description: Multiple package names to validate in one call.

name: viberaven_validate_npm_package
